## Change

Type: Planning / Implementation
Level: Small / Standard / High-risk
Reason for level or owner override:
Task ID:
Plan: `specifications/planned/<id>/plan.md` (planning) / `specifications/implemented/<id>/plan.md` (implementation) / brief PR summary (Small)
Summary:

## Planning-only PR

- [ ] Plan is clear and ready for review
- [ ] No implementation release/version bump

## Implementation PR

- [ ] Code self-checks completed
- [ ] Code review completed at the selected level (or Small self-review)
- [ ] Final tests/checks completed at the selected level
- [ ] Evidence links record exact commit and known limitations
- [ ] Plan moved to implemented (Standard/High-risk)
- [ ] Version and changelog prepared; current spec/README updated **if needed**

## Approval

**Stop before merge.** Project owner must explicitly approve the completed implementation, regardless of level. Planning approval is not implementation merge approval.
